Emily (Partnerships): FYI team — KDDI reached out about onboarding to their marketplace for the new jp-south-2 region. They need ops sign-off on capacity, certs, and a quota request. Can we run through checklist? :wave:
Hiro Tanaka: nice. what SKU / capacity are they requesting? timeline?
Emily (Partnerships): Early ask: reserved pool: 8 x A100-80GB + burst to 16 for first 30 days. Initial quota window target is 3/25–4/30 for ramp tests. They also want SOC2 + network peering playbook before go-live.
Matt O'Leary: copying the quota numbers into the quota service. We'll need the exact instance type string for their marketplace. Is it `a100.80gb` or vendor-specific naming? Also do we have a fallback quantized model profile for smaller GPUs?
Sarah - CloudOps: We can offer a fallback to 4xA30-32GB pool for non-critical workloads. For marketplace listing we should recommend two SKUs: `a100-80gb-rr` (reserved) and `a30-fallback`. I'll add autoscale policy template.
Hiro Tanaka: legal tells me KDDI requested keying options: customer-managed KMS required for Private deployments. Do they require HSM attestation?
Emily (Partnerships): KDDI's onboarding checklist: KMS yes, HSM optional but preferred for enterprise customers. They've asked for our brokered KMS integration pattern. I already shared the high-level doc with them.
Matt O'Leary: created quota ticket Q-2043 with internal reference. link: https://redwood-internal/ops/quotas/Q-2043 — put the requested numbers in the ticket body.
kddi-onboard-bot: Quota ticket Q-2043 created by Matt. Status: pending-approval. Assigned to: Sarah - CloudOps. ETA for review: 24h.
Sarah - CloudOps: I'll triage Q-2043 after stand. Quick checklist from my side: 1) confirm marketplace SKU strings 2) confirm network peering window and IP space 3) validate GPU provisioning template 4) schedule CPC (capacity planning call) with partner.
Hiro Tanaka: On compliance — who owns SOC2 artifacts sharing with KDDI? I can surface them but need Legal to approve redacted versions.
Emily (Partnerships): Legal (cc'd externally) asked for a pointer to any cross-border data flows. For jp-south-2 KDDI will host compute in their region, so cross-border minimal, but we need to capture telemetry retention in the agreement.
Matt O'Leary: ops question — what's our fallback policy if KDDI capacity dips? Do we auto-route to hosted in eu-west or failover to smaller SKUs? Need an explicit fallback for the marketplace listing copy.
Sarah - CloudOps: Proposed fallback: route to dedicated eu-west1 pool if latency SLO allows, otherwise serve degraded capacity on a30-fallback. I'll draft an SLA fallback matrix and attach to Q-2043.
Hiro Tanaka: timeline sync: partner wants soft launch 04/15, internal GA 05/01. That gives us ~3 weeks to get quotas + certs in place. Tight but doable if Legal + CloudOps move fast.
Emily (Partnerships): Action items: - Sarah: review Q-2043 and post SLA fallback matrix (due 24h) - Hiro: coordinate SOC2 redaction + share with Legal (due EOD) - Matt: confirm SKU strings & update ticket (done: please verify) - Emily: schedule CPC with KDDI for tomorrow 09:30 JST.
Matt O'Leary: confirmed SKU strings with our model registry: `redwood.a100.80g.rsv`, `redwood.a30.32g.fallback`. Updated Q-2043.
kddi-onboard-bot: Reminder: CPC meeting invite sent to KDDI + Redwood. Meeting ID: 794-211-019. Calendar shows 2024-03-26 09:30 JST.
Sarah - CloudOps: I'll draft the peering playbook snippet and paste below in the ticket. Quick note: preferred maintenance window is 02:00–05:00 JST. If partner can't do that, we need a change runbook.
Emily (Partnerships): Thanks all. I'll ping Legal and KDDI with the CPC invite. If we can close Q-2043 and SOC2 redaction in 48h we can hit soft launch window. :crossed_fingers:
Hiro Tanaka: ack. I'll start the SOC2 redaction now and loop Legal.
Emily (Partnerships): Closing comment — please react with :thumbsup: when you complete your action items so I can update the partner.
